QUOTE: Installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or the `_mutexed` wrappers when threading is on, via `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the init function installs the plain pair or the `_mutexed` pair depending on whether threading (MBEDTLS_THREADING_C) is on. The mechanism and location match the item. It doesn't say outright that the choice is made at compile time, but the `#if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` condition implies it.
